data_use.source: GBIF occurrence/search facets, GBIF Backbone numeric speciesKey
data_use.relative_period: 2001–2010 only, BEFORE butterfly 2011–2022 outcome records in source 51 landmasses
data_use.interpretation: Observed country indexing breadth, not native butterfly range, historical endemicity, abundance or established populations
data_use.reproducibility: Timestamped independent API snapshot, neither a GBIF record-ID download nor source-provider DOI
data_use.rate_limit_compliance: At most 4 concurrent country facet calls, bounded HTTP429 backoff; no screen scraping
data_use.rights: No coordinates or individual butterflies recorded in this archive; counts aggregated by GBIF country facet
